svg.text: OzAgriMate Runtime Diagram 2 - Irrigation request and processing (UML sequence)
Irrigation and Alerts container | prototype implements the REST Controller to Repository steps (4-9, 14-15); dashed Mobile App and API Gateway are target architecture; steps 18-22 are planned
opt [request is still PENDING] - implemented: PUT /farms/{farmId}/irrigation-requests/{requestId}
PLANNED - outside the two implemented endpoints; the prototype never applies water
20. Dispatch approved schedule + expiry [via Event Broker]
22. Run within local limits; stop at expiry
Safe state: after 48 hours without cloud contact the controller stops automatic watering and reverts to manual control.
A disconnected controller cannot receive cloud cancellations; schedule expiry and local overrides are the safeguard (ADR-03).
Prototype: Mobile App and API Gateway are not implemented. Postman calls the REST Controller directly at 127.0.0.1:8003, standing in for steps 1-3, 10-13 and 16-17.
